_note: Input table for tools/north-sea-map.js. Edit a status here, then run: node tools/north-sea-map.js
Show project names only. Never write the name of a company in this file, not even in a URL.
group 1: project in a depleted gas field. group 2: pilot or study. group 3: project in a saline aquifer.
points: [lat, lon] pairs from the research file. The marker stands at the mean of the points.
outlines.nsta: exact FIELDNAME values of the NSTA layer. outlines.nlog: FIELD_CODE values of the NLOG layer.
year: the main year of the status (the target start, the start of operation, or the year of the last milestone). null if none.

groups.name: Project in a depleted gas field
Gas field that no longer produces
groups.list: Gas fields that no longer produce

projects.name: HyNet / Liverpool Bay CCS
projects.status: Storage permits granted in Apr 2025. First injection as soon as mid-2028.

projects.name: Morecambe Net Zero
projects.status: The gas fields still produce. Storage can start in 2030, after a final investment decision and approvals.

projects.name: Viking CCS
projects.status: Government development funding approved in Jul 2026. No final investment decision yet.

projects.name: Poseidon
projects.status: Storage licence CS009 (2023). Injection test at the Leman field in 2025. Target start 2030.

projects.name: Orion
projects.status: Storage licences CS017 and CS018 (2023). Target start 2031.

projects.name: Bacton CCS
projects.status: Storage licence awarded in 2023. Appraisal well drilled in 2025. Target: first injection by 2030.

projects.name: Camelot CCS
projects.status: Withdrawing (2026). In Jun 2026 a licence holder said it will apply to give up storage licence CS019.

projects.name: Porthos
projects.status: Storage permits final since Sep 2022. Final investment decision in Oct 2023. In construction. Start not before the second half of 2027.

projects.name: Aramis
projects.status: Permits granted. An appeal against the permits is pending. Final investment decision planned for 2027. Operation planned for 2030.

projects.name: Q16-FA
projects.status: A storage permit application was received (official notice of 14 Oct 2025).

projects.name: L09-FF
projects.status: A storage permit application was received (official notice of 23 Sep 2025).

projects.name: Bifrost
projects.status: Exploration licence approved in Feb 2023. Possible capacity: more than 5 million tonnes of CO₂ a year by 2030.

projects.name: K12-B
projects.status: CO₂ injection pilot from 2004. More than 100,000 tonnes injected. The operation is complete.

projects.name: Peterhead / Goldeneye
projects.status: Plan to store CO₂ in a depleted gas field. Called off in 2015, after the government cancelled its CCS competition.

projects.name: Frigg
projects.status: Gas production ended in 2004. A 2010 state study modelled CO₂ injection into the field.

projects.name: Heimdal
projects.status: A 2016 study found storage here possible but less attractive than at Smeaheia.

projects.name: Endurance
projects.status: Storage permit granted in Dec 2024. In construction. Start-up expected in 2028.

projects.name: Acorn
projects.status: Government agreed about £200 million for development in Jun 2025, subject to a business case. The money is for work before a final investment decision.

projects.name: Northern Lights
projects.status: Injecting since 2025.

projects.name: Sleipner
projects.status: Injecting since 1996.

projects.name: Smeaheia
projects.status: Exploration licence awarded in 2022. Two wells in 2025 showed that the reservoir suits CO₂ storage.
